ModMetaData.name: Cultural Ritual Limits
ModMetaData.author: Pooi
ModMetaData.description:
原版 Ideology 文化仪式（招募仪式）招来的小人经常强得离谱。这个 mod 允许你限制仪式招募的小人的强度：默认情况下，招募来的小人所有技能等级最高只有 3，十足的臭鱼烂虾。上限可以在 Mod 设置里自由调整（0~20）。
The pawns recruited through the vanilla Ideology recruitment ritual are often way too strong. This mod lets you cap their power: by default, ritual recruits have all skills capped at level 3. The cap is fully configurable in the mod settings (0-20).
- 只影响文化仪式招募的小人，不影响随机流浪者、逃生舱等其他来源 / Only affects ritual recruits, not random wanderers or other join events. - 可选：同时移除被招募小人的技能兴趣 / Optional: also strip skill passions. - 随时可在设置中调整或关闭（把上限调回 20 即等于关闭）/ Configurable at any time; set the cap back to 20 to disable.
